bounded_goal: Move SOCC from accepted bounded plan proposal surface toward a visible controlled foreground cycle by defining finite, measurable, proof-bound, non-executing planning steps.

bounded_steps.expected_artifact: authority observation embedded in validation/review proof
bounded_steps.summary: Read route/pulse/control and confirm current_lawful_next before any future cycle.
Define what every visible controlled SOCC cycle must show: current, decision, boundary, proof, result, next.
Prepare a finite foreground controlled cycle packet with proof requirements and no daemon/background/network.
Stop after proposal/packet construction and require validation, review, and acceptance before any future run surface.

expected_effect: SOCC has a compliant first bounded plan proposal packet
packet contains finite non-executing steps with expected artifacts
packet defines measurable visibility requirements before any future cycle
packet names proof and validation requirements before review
route remains at validation frontier until validation PASS
forbidden_actions: mutate route authority outside lawful transition
repair_reason: Previous simplified build produced a malformed packet that failed validation. This repair restores required bounded plan schema fields without advancing route.
truth_boundary: This bounded plan packet is a proposal only. It cannot execute, run code, mutate route outside lawful transition, start daemon/background, use network, create MW route, claim AGI, or launch autonomy.
validation_requirements: bounded_steps must be finite and non-empty
each bounded step must have may_execute false
forbidden_actions must include execution, daemon, background, network, MW, AGI/autonomy claims
